guidance.paragraph1: The tribunal will usually make its decision based on the documents and evidence provided by you and the landlord.
guidance.paragraph2: Only ask for an inspection if you think there are reasons that your evidence cannot show.
guidance.paragraph3: The tribunal will decide if an inspection is needed.

questionTitle: Do you agree to the tribunal making a decision without an inspection?

noDecisionWithoutInspectionReason.label: Tell us why you think an inspection is needed
noDecisionWithoutInspectionReason.hint: For example, if the condition or quality of the property is not shown properly in pictures - describe this in detail

agreeToDecisionWithoutInspection.required: Select yes if you agree to the tribunal making a decision without an inspection

noDecisionWithoutInspectionReason.required: Enter why you think an inspection is needed
noDecisionWithoutInspectionReason.invalid: Why you think an inspection is needed must be 500 characters or fewer
